ground.note: Every surface tile joins every other of the same surface, in any order.
ground.edgesNote: Each corner set has 16 tiles, numbered by the corners covered by the second surface, added up (north 1, east 2, south 4, west 8). Tile 0 is all the first surface, tile 15 all the second.

cliffs.note: A block fills its cell from the ground up: draw it with its bottom at the cell's bottom, like any tile, and stack blocks for taller cliffs (each one rise higher). Sides are blocks without a top: lay any ground tile on them, one rise up. Draw cells back to front.

water.coasts: Coast tiles are named by the neighbours that are water, added up. A corner only counts when both sides next to it are land, so there are 46 shapes.
